items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I think Larry Barbrand's dad was one of the musicians playing in that band at that time, yes.

ctx.x: Did you hear any bands go by at all?

Well, yes, I remember, used to have parades pass all these streets sometimes, you know. Or, they were on Claiborne where my mother's, I tell you when we were small, I tell you what would happen. My grandmother would bring us on Canal Street to see the carnival parades. Yeah, and then, I remember her bringing us on Claiborne Street to see a group called the Hobgoblins. I've heard of them, yeah. The Hobgoblins. And them old time musicians was playing for them Hobgoblins. I think Larry Barbrand's dad was one of the…
Do you remember any of the early dance bands that you hear when you were younger? Like on a wagon or anything, advertising maybe?
